## Mandatory rejections

Confirm review of:

- server actions;
- Prisma/PostgreSQL;
- Better Auth;
- Stripe;
- advertising/premium;
- email;
- leaderboards/social;
- donor UI framework dependencies;
- unverified media.

## Direct code reuse

Every C item must also be added to `THIRD_PARTY_CODE_MAP.md`.
